about.heading: A bit about me!
paragraphs: I'm an undergraduate student at Simon Fraser University with a passion for building projects to make people's lives easier. Solving problems and turning ideas into functional projects is what I call fun!

Outside of coding, I have a strong passion for physical health and fitness. I love to cook, weightlift, play basketball, hike, but above all I love to run. Currently planning to do my second full marathon! I really enjoy the balance and applying the same consistency and mindset from training to the way I approach development and tech.
